create_health_servicer: create a HealthServicer instance to handle gRPC health check RPCs for service statuses
set_service_status: set the health status of a named service using HealthServicer set method
check_service_health: check the health status of a gRPC service by calling the Check RPC method
watch_service_health: watch for health status changes on a gRPC service using the Watch streaming RPC
enter_graceful_shutdown: enter graceful shutdown mode by setting all services to NOT_SERVING status
